column1: # The statics of compiler/src (0.28.0), for `fix --edition rust`'s
# table.vl's static_rows): a tab-separated row per static,
#   verdict   atomic: an Atomic<T>, read and written Relaxed (one thread
#             touches it); justified: its accessors' unsafe blocks carry
#             the two lines below; unverified or race: no lines
#   unsafe    the UNSAFE: line (why it cannot be safe)
#   safety    the SAFETY: line (why it is sound); for atomic, the comment
# A static of no row gets accessors without comments. The atomic rows
# are those no function either thread entry (middle::threads::
# worker_main, asm_thread_main) reaches calls, by `volec query callees
# --transitive` of each and `volec query refs` of the static.
